title: Ang Pagkukumpol
setup: Nagsalita si Nurse Lea — ang unang boses. 'Hindi ito aksidente. May resibo, pero walang proyekto.' Tahimik ang lahat. Hinihintay kung sino ang susunod.
setup_en: Nurse Lea speaks — the first voice. 'This wasn't an accident. There's a receipt, but no project.' Everyone is quiet. They wait to see who speaks next.

success.text: Sumama ka. Sumama rin ang mga Galit na Kapitbahay.
success.text_en: You join. The Angry Neighbors join too.

success.text: Tumayo ka nang mag-isa. Isang boses pa.
success.text_en: You stand alone. One more voice.

fail.text: Mahirap, pero nagsalita ka. Isang boses pa.
fail.text_en: It's hard, but you spoke. One more voice.

callback: Voice count +1/+2. Cascade builds toward Worried Parents.
